description:
A well defined, extra-axial lesion in the left frontoparietal region with iso-signal intensity comparing to gray matter in T1 weighted images and in T2 weighted images.

Post-contrast avid enhancement is noted and evident dural tail sign.

CSF fluid noted surrounding the lesion, a CSF cleft sign.

Peripheral mild edema is noted.
